A new Pew Report says Muslims will overtake Christians as the largest religious group by 2035. The report titled ‘The Future of the World Religions’ also talks about how Hindus, Buddhists, Jews and religiously unaffiliated groups are projected to grow or shrink.
ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta explains the key takeaways from this latest report, and draws from a February 2026 report by Pew on religious diversity around the world. Watch Episode 1939
